name: Release CLI changeset hold
reason: Release versions are bound to their version commits; later CLI changesets cannot enter an existing release.

name: ci-checks-generated: Install Safe Chain
reason: Safe Chain moved to the dedicated lockfile-change dependency-malware gate (and the nightly)

name: ci-checks-policy: Install Safe Chain
reason: Safe Chain moved to the dedicated lockfile-change dependency-malware gate (and the nightly)

name: ci-checks-rest: Install Safe Chain
reason: Safe Chain moved to the dedicated lockfile-change dependency-malware gate (and the nightly)

name: CLI registry snapshot guard
reason: Replaced by CLI committed registry and derived runtime guard: checks committed projections separately and verifies ignored runtime generation.

name: CLI committed registry and derived runtime guard
reason: Replaced by CLI sharded registry and derived runtime guard: derives the API capability runtime from committed shards before regenerating the CLI registry and runtime.

name: Web API types drift guard
reason: Replaced by the determinism guard; the generated API types file is no longer committed

name: Select measured ratchet base
reason: Renamed to Select measured ratchet base from the target branch; it now measures from the pull request's base branch instead of main

name: Marketing content evidence
reason: Renamed to Marketing content check; it now runs with the package checks, after the dependency install

name: Release marketing freshness warning
reason: Renamed to Release marketing staleness warning; it now runs with the package checks, after the dependency install

name: Model catalog snapshot drift guard
reason: Renamed to Model catalog snapshot drift check; it now runs with the package checks, after the dependency install

name: MCP App bundle guard
reason: Replaced by MCP App bundle and shared assets guard: regenerates the existing HTML bundles and also checks their shared generated messages, schemas and stylesheet.

name: Release marketing staleness warning
reason: Replaced by Release marketing provenance warning: CI checks source provenance without invoking rendered screenshots; rendered freshness remains covered by the marketing screenshot job.

name: API test duration weights
reason: Replaced by main-run duration aggregation and cached weights consumed by API test shards.

name: Test autofix decision boundaries
reason: Replaced by Test autofix protected paths; API duration weights are no longer repository files managed by autofix.

name: Test migration identity and merge gate logic
reason: Renamed to Test migration identity logic after removing the repository merge CLI.

name: Test merge bar freshness, arm guard and disarm
reason: Removed with the repository merge CLI; pull requests now enter the merge queue directly.

name: Test merge queue jump-reset recovery
reason: Removed with the repository merge CLI and its queue-position recovery behavior.

name: MCP App bundle and shared assets guard
reason: Replaced by MCP app package bundles and shared assets guard: builds the frontend package, regenerates its API-derived contracts, checks all committed bundle assets, and enforces per-app bundle budgets.

name: Select typecheck parity coverage
reason: Compiler parity and seeded compiler probes run only through explicit Manual checks dispatch.

name: Typecheck parity (all checked projects)
reason: Compiler parity and seeded compiler probes run only through explicit Manual checks dispatch.

name: Record typecheck parity report
reason: Compiler parity and seeded compiler probes run only through explicit Manual checks dispatch.

name: Upload typecheck parity report
reason: Compiler parity and seeded compiler probes run only through explicit Manual checks dispatch.

name: Typecheck command rejects errors
reason: Compiler parity and seeded compiler probes run only through explicit Manual checks dispatch.

name: Dependabot group guard
reason: Reads installed manifests, so it moved to ci-checks-policy after the install as 'Dependabot group guard (installed packages)'.

name: MCP app package bundles and shared assets guard
reason: Its outputs are derived before use and no longer committed, so it became 'MCP app derived outputs guard': it builds them, checks the bundle budgets, and fails when an output is missing, empty, or tracked again.

name: Published export map guard
reason: Renamed to Workspace package export map guard; @stll/time is published from stella/tooling now, so its export check left the workspace list with the package

name: Check workflow job classifications
reason: Moved to ci-quick-checks unchanged in substance (same tooling checkout at the workflow revision and the same command), so it fails a pull request before the heavy suites start.

name: Test merge-group ancestor check
reason: The merge queue now requires every entry's own group to pass before it merges (ALLGREEN), so the polling step it tested and the step's script were removed.

name: exactMirror route guard
reason: Elysia's exactMirror response normalization is gone with Elysia; the HTTP core parses every response through its route schema, which the response schema tests cover.
